==Notes==
*Good synergy with [["Dodge This!"]], [["Go for the Eyes!"]] and [["The Power Is Yours!"]].
*When using shouts or chants that end when using an attack skill, Purifying Finale will remove a condition :
** After the next attack if [["Find Their Weakness!"]], [[Anthem of Envy]] or [[Anthem of Flame]] ends. 
** Before the next attack if [["Go for the Eyes!"]], [[Anthem of Weariness]] or [[Anthem of Disruption]] ends.
